items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Pops Foster with Darnell Howard, April 21st, 1957... So we're going to go in the room, we're going to talk to some Spurridge... we're supposed to call him Spurridge... we talk about that foolish talk.

ctx.x: Yeah, take it away. Uh, all right. We want some more things, shall we tell you or shall we call down, please? Call down. Call down. Call down. Call down. Call down. Call down. Call down.

Pops Foster with Darnell Howard, April 21st, 1957, reel four. So we're going to go in the room, we're going to talk to some Spurridge. He's supposed to have a chicken come off this room, so we wouldn't have had this chicken. So put all the lights on, put the table in the middle of the floor, they'd sit over there, and I'm sitting over there on the corner. We're supposed to call him Spurridge, you know. Spurridge was supposed to come, Paul in bed. He's in bed half asleep, all the juice, and we're going to call it…
You don't have to rush time. You have to wait for this one, don't you?

items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I went to school with Foster.

ctx.x: What were the different acts in that show? I joined in Foster, was one.

What were they, comedians? Yes. Real tall guy. I went to school with Foster. Bit of short guy. Was this an all-colored show? Uh-huh. And Harper and Banks. Harper was a producer. Banks was his wife. You know, that was his show name. Uh-huh. What'd they do? Well, they danced, sang, danced. I can't think of a woman's name that sang so good. Naomi Thomas. Naomi Thomas? Don't you know her?
